Reading · z is the underlying's move after the decision, net of its market
  exposure, in units of its own daily noise; positive means the move went the
  decision's way. Each entry week counts once. The e-value is the weight of
  evidence for information in the decisions (100 is the bar); the posterior
  gives the chance the true mean z per week exceeds 0.05 and 0.10.
A sleeve is established only when every gate passes; until then nothing here
  says whether the decisions carry information. Read-only review of past fills;
  it places no orders.
